experiment.name: queue_based_development_1800
experiment.title: Queue-based controller development, 1800 s
experiment.description: Development-only parameter screen. Seeds 701–715 are excluded from final validation. Predeclared eligibility: at 18 and 24 vehicles/min/approach, mean queue area and residual must be lower and throughput no lower than original; at symmetric 3 and 6, completed wait and mean queue may not worsen by more than 10%. Among eligible variants, choose the lowest 18/min mean queue area; ties prefer the smaller relative margin, then shorter minimum green. The final seed set is untouched during selection.
